Subject: Private hosting deep-dive — request and possible slots

Hi Sean / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — our execs were impressed with the perf numbers. Our compliance and infra teams want a technical deep-dive focused on private hosting options (VPC peering, air-gap variants, on-prem appliance model), and we'd like to lock in a session next week to walk through network/topology requirements and certificate/KMS controls.

Possible windows (PST):
- Wed May 5: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Thu May 6: 09:30–10:30 or 14:00–15:00

Attendees from our side: myself (Product), Priya Sharma (Network Lead), Compliance (cc'ed). Please include your solutions engineer and someone who can answer questions on KV cache persistence and data-at-rest encryption.

I attached our current network diagram to give you context. Also: will you be able to share a checklist for air-gapped deploy constraints ahead of time? Compliance wants an initial read before the call.

Thanks,
Rajiv
Rajiv Singh
Director, Platform Product
Quanta Therapeutics
[Attachment: current_network_diagram.pdf (PDF)]

Rajiv — great to hear. We can absolutely run the deep-dive and prep an air-gap checklist for you. Proposed approach and next steps: 

1) Confirm final slot (I can do either Wed 5/5 15:00–16:00 PST or Thu 5/6 14:00–15:00 PST). Which fits your compliance team?
2) Proposed agenda (45–60 min): 15 min infra/topology walkthrough; 20 min security controls (KMS, network zoning, audit logs); 10–15 min open Q&A + next steps.
3) Attendees on our side: myself (sales/solutions lead), Lauren Bishop (Solutions Engineer, will cover network/KV/cache details), and Marissa Cole (Customer Success / commercial).
4) Pre-reads we will push to the Drive link below: private deployment checklist, network requirements doc, and a v2 system-architecture deck. Please send any CSPM or internal questionnaire items you want covered.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/qtx/arch-prep

I've attached our short prep checklist; Lauren will add a one-page air-gapped constraints summary by EOD tomorrow. 

Attachments: redwood_private_deploy_prep_checklist.docx

If Wed 5/5 15:00 PST works, I'll send the calendar invite and include dial-in details. If compliance prefers Thu, we can move.

Best,

Sean / Lauren — suggestion: can we put a 20-minute internal prep call on Wed 5/5 11:00 PST so we validate the v2 deck and make sure we have answers for the retention/KMS questions? Lauren, can you confirm you'll prepare the air-gap constraints one-pager Rajiv asked for?

Thanks — will stand by for the confirmed slot.

Appreciate it,
Rajiv
